env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^39 <nil>$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep '/\* a \*/' out/main.go
grep '/\* b \*/' out/main.go
grep '// c' out/main.go
grep '/\* e \*/' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/grouprangehead

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync/atomic"
)

func feed1(a int) chan int {
	ch := make(chan int, 1)
	ch <- a
	close(ch)
	return ch
}

func feed2(a, b int) chan int {
	ch := make(chan int, 2)
	ch <- a
	ch <- b
	close(ch)
	return ch
}

func drain(ctx context.Context, total *atomic.Int64) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			for v := /* a */ range feed2(1, 2) {
				total.Add(int64(v))
			}
		}
		go {
			for v /* b */ := range feed2(3, 4) {
				total.Add(int64(v))
			}
		}
		go {
			for w := // c
				range feed2(5, 6) {
				total.Add(int64(w))
			}
		}
		go {
			n := 0
			for /* d */ range feed1(7) {
				n++
			}
			total.Add(int64(n))
		}
		go {
			var v int
			for v = /* e */ range feed2(8, 9) {
				total.Add(int64(v))
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	var total atomic.Int64
	err := drain(context.Background(), &total)
	fmt.Println(total.Load(), err)
}
